label: Grain Elev.
brief: Modern co-op grain terminal beside the tracks: a cluster of corrugated galvanized steel bins (the three 11 m parts) fed by a tall lattice leg tower with inclined conveyor galleries and catwalks. A slender stacked-ring wet-holding tank, a hopper-bottom bin on legs and a small white steel scale/office shed sit at the foot of the leg; gravel yard all round.
